name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's sex is female at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's sex is documented as female at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's sex is documented as not female (i.e., male or other) at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_invasive_carcinoma_of_breast_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of invasive carcinoma of breast.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of invasive carcinoma of breast.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of invasive carcinoma of breast.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of invasive carcinoma of breast.

when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a newly diagnosed invasive carcinoma of breast.
